x: At Chelsea Bridge the leaders made a break and Wood(Sheffield), Mayatt(Aylesford), Gilligan(Pembroke) and Eales(Tipton) opened up a thirty yards lead from seven others (including Pete) by Queens Road Circus.
Charlie Walker set off on leg 5 and soon passed Chelmsford to regain sixth place but was eventually overtaken by Mayatt of Aylesford and Irons of Victoria Park.

On the penultimate leg Charlie Dabbs moved away from Woodford in excellent fashion but eventually had to give way to Mayatt (APM).
